# Research Papers

> A maintained research library with a 488,491-record operator corpus, a 478,991-record public analytics snapshot, selected indexes, citation analytics, reading paths, and cited answers.

## When to use this

Use Research Papers when someone needs to investigate a concrete technical or market question through academic literature. The retained corpus contains records from arXiv, OpenReview, bioRxiv, and medRxiv. The public site exposes selected indexes, PageRank and reviewer signals, reading paths, downloadable JSON, and a cited-answer route. The complete semantic index remains an operator-side capability.

## Product

- [Home](https://papers.highsignal.app/): Search and analytics

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://papers.highsignal.app/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://papers.highsignal.app/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 of public agent surfaces
- [Homepage markdown](https://papers.highsignal.app/index.md): Product brief without JS
